notes: Prospectus dated May 24, 2021 (Form 424B1) for a primary rights offering. Record date May 24, 2021; expiration June 28, 2021 at 5:00 p.m. Eastern unless extended, and the excerpt states no extension. The subscription price is stated as 95% of the lower of the average NYSE sale price over the pricing window and NAV on the expiration date; no floor is stated, so price_floor_pct_nav is null. max_new_shares is the approximately 8,528,621 primary shares as stated; the secondary over-subscription of up to 25% is excluded.
